lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance blobs are arranged in a regular matrix of approximately 5-6 visible vertical columns and 6-8 horizontal rows between the fifth gill slit and the dorsal fin origin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a grid-like appearance where the spots serve as high-intensity nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal ridges are visible; a primary ridge runs along the upper flank with a sharp light-to-dark vertical gradient, and a secondary, less-defined ridge is visible closer to the dorsal midline.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a sparse distribution of small, high-luminance spots, with approximately 4-6 distinct pixel clusters located primarily along the anterior edge and basal region.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of approximately 10-12 elongated, low-luminance silhouettes (remoras) is visible directly beneath and trailing the pectoral fin.
